_comment: Pinned per-role inputs for dist/<role>/config.yaml (specs/728-D.md D2 shape; specs/728-EF.md D6/D8). Only roles listed here get a generated config.yaml. Portal include = the union of `phases[p]` for p in `active_phases`, mapped through contract-mapping.json and prefixed to served names. A W-step is a data change here (+ the matching Cloudflare flip), never a code change. W1-W3 sets are recorded but NOT rendered until listed in active_phases. Roles without a `portal` key are personal-mcp-only: they render a single-server config.yaml (model + personal-mcp). `gate_wake_kinds` (728-D plan D3; 728-EF D10) renders dist/<role>/scripts/gate.py from generator/data/gate.py.tmpl — one shared logic, per-role wake-kind constants. G2 (2026-11-17): Writer advances to W1 (active_phases construction+W1, matching the C1 Cloudflare flip) and its Google reads move from the writer portal to personal-mcp — the portal construction set keeps only the Linear reads, and group:gmail_read + group:calendar join Writer's personal_mcp_allow; the portal's Google read-back mapping rows stay dormant in contract-mapping.json (rollback = restore the construction gmail/google-calendar sets + drop the two groups).

personal_mcp.source: personal-mcp src/auth/tool_scopes.json @ cab7aaa (main, byte-identical when read 2026-11-13); live tools/list counts writer 18 / librarian 14 confirmed by the 728-C batch (mint-harvest-2026-11-10.md). Groups gmail_read + calendar added 2026-11-17 (G2) from personal-mcp main 0157538 src/auth/tool_scopes.json (groups gmail_read/calendar, verbatim, in file order): sub=writer is granted group:gmail_read + group:calendar server-side there, so Writer's scope total is 27.

writer.personal_mcp_note: SHADOW withholding (728-D D5 step 3): gmail_send and gmail_delete are withheld — sub=writer loses both server-side in personal-mcp src/auth/tool_scopes.json, and this include list matches (include ⊆ scope is a hard battery rule). This replaces the former group:gmail expansion (10 names) with the explicit 8-name list. Restore is a paired change: re-add gmail_send + gmail_delete here AND restore them to writer's server-side scope in the same change set; never one side alone. Google reads (G2, 2026-11-17): group:gmail_read (6) + group:calendar (5) join the allow — personal-mcp already grants both to sub=writer server-side (tool_scopes.json @ 0157538), so the rendered include is 27 names (16 + 11) and still excludes gmail_send/gmail_delete; these reads replace the writer portal's gmail/google-calendar read names, mirroring Scout's direct-Google-legs move (gb PR #22).
